library_versions.meaning: library version ranges (card OPENSSL-PROVIDER-PLUGIN, contract spec C06.2): a declaration stating `resource_library_version(LIB, since|documented V[, removed W])` is in force only where the version the audited build's headers report (read from the crate's library-versions.json source by preprocessing under every include configuration) is readable, unambiguous, within [V, W) and equal to the version its lock pins; a version that only differs from the pinned one is held as contract-pin-mismatch (Pending: review and re-pin), and out of range, unreadable or ambiguous holds every call Unknown
